title: Table for Two
subtitle: Two SO-101 arms set a dinner table from one sentence — planned and driven on OpenVINO
event: AI Infra Summit Hackathon · Intel Physical AI Online Challenge · September 2026
failure_note: Policy (120k steps): plate, drawer + mug, fork 8-10/10. From a scripted start: pour 3/10 (84% of the water in, but >2 beads spilled), bottle back 10/10, hand-over 5/10. Chained, those states drift and script takeovers knock placed items, so no run sets the whole table.
hardware_note: Measured on Intel Core i9-14900HX + Raptor Lake iGPU; bench/benchmark.py reproduces every number on a Core Ultra in one command.
